_comment: 🧩️ This subset's own contribution. `s.sequence.sequence` declares ONE mutation vocabulary across two facets — `🧬️schema/🧬️mutations` holds the dispatch enum and the per-kind triad leaves, `🚪️io/🧬️mutations` holds that same enum's text and binary wire codecs — so ONE catalog registers both. The `kinds` are the kebab spelling of `SequenceMutation`'s variants in declaration order; `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/🦀️component.rs`'s `KINDS` const and its `kinds_match_the_enum_and_the_catalog` test keep this file, that const and the enum in agreement.

noOracleDecisions.rationale: `s.sequence.sequence` is a semio-NATIVE artifact. Its persisted document is the `sequence.sequence.dsl` envelope — `semio sequence.sequence.dsl v1` followed by hex-encoded fields and a bracketed composed-child handle — and its step graph lives in a composed `s.stdio.semio.flow` CHILD addressed by a content-derived handle. No package in any ecosystem reads or writes that envelope: the preamble, the hex field grammar and the child-handle addressing are defined by this repository alone, so there is nothing to register and nothing authoritative over `SequenceMutation` — that vocabulary IS this subset's own specification. The nearest candidates were surveyed and DECLINED rather than merely absent. (1) A generic JSON reader (json-rust is already linked into the stdio oracle crate and every mutation here serializes as internally-tagged JSON) supplies a DOM and no knowledge of a step, an id-keyed collection, a slot or an edge cascade, so all eight mutation semantics — the entire content of this catalog — would still be hand-written on top of it; calling that a third-party reference would overstate the evidence. (2) The workflow/DAG domain has real third-party libraries (BPMN and Graphviz readers), and they were rejected on a substantive point rather than on absence: none of them models THIS graph. `delete-step` cascades every incident edge inside its own diff, `duplicate-step` mints a second step from a source id, `edit-step-params` carries an opaque `Dictionary` whose integer/decimal distinction a generic graph format erases — a differential against a BPMN or DOT reader would compare two different documents and report agreement about neither. Confidence comes instead from specification vectors — this subset's own committed per-kind leaf fixtures under `../🧬️schema/🧬️mutations/<kind>/🧪️tests/`, each an independently authored `(before, mutation, after|absent, outcome)` quadruple — and from the metamorphic laws the case asserts in role: every kind must MOVE the semantic projection, every kind's own computed inverse must restore it exactly, and the committed real artifact must survive decode/encode byte-for-byte.
